title: Wind and seismic detailing.
officialText:
Lateral-force-resisting systems shall meet seismic detailing requirements and limitations
prescribed in this code and ASCE 7-10, excluding ASCE 7-10 Chapter 14 and ASCE 7-10 Appendix 11A, even when wind load
effects are greater than seismic load effects.
SECTION BC 1605
LOAD COMBINATIONS
